column1: # Domain authority list — the "famous websites per category" corpus, used for RANKING, not bulk
# crawling. A page from one of these domains (however it entered the index — usually pulled in by
# query-driven SERP discovery) gets this domain's authority as a ranking signal, so the well-known
# answer surfaces above a random blog that happens to match the same words.
#   - domain:    registrable host, no scheme, no www. A subdomain matches its parent too.
#   - authority: 0-100, how well-known/authoritative the domain is IN GENERAL. Scaled to 0-1 at load.
#   - region:    informational (global | mena | dz | fr | intl). Algeria-first is handled separately:
#                any .dz host gets a home floor even when it is not listed here, so this list does not
#                need every Algerian site — it names the ones worth an explicit, higher score.
# Keep this Algeria-first: Algerian entries sit at the top of the scale; global sites sit just below
# so they fill gaps and win on relevance, but a home site takes a tie. Authority is a small weight —
# a tie-breaker among documents that already match, never a way to float an irrelevant page up.
